openings.claim: Separate lateral registration from seal compression using two removable, padded edge yokes; stronger corner pressure may be unnecessary for resisting the sideways pull.
openings.delta: Drill only the four strips to form two bolted strip pairs. If the rim permits, each pair sandwiches hatch and rim, with outboard bolt shafts registering opposing hatch edges along the pull axis. Rubber pads protect contact surfaces. Set nuts to the least compression that retains the hatch. Tie removable hardware together with cord and withdraw both yokes completely onto the tabletop before inspection.
openings.prediction: Against the nearest rival, the same yokes tightened mainly for friction, registration with lighter compression should reduce pull displacement without reproducing the opposite-corner lift. The final right-contact card may defeat friction-only retention while registered edges still limit sideways motion. These differences are hypotheses; either version may rock or exceed 1 mm.
openings.probe: Use two rival closure/pull trials, one centered and one with the right-contact card, then ten successive registered-yoke opening cycles with a closure/pull trial each; make cycle ten the disturbed final closure. This uses twelve trials and two configurations. Record marked-position displacement, opposite-corner lift, reopening time, and visible seal tears. Compare the two disturbed trials for discrimination; the rival receives no ten-cycle durability claim. Stop on tears or unsafe retention. Verify the registered version meets every valued requirement through cycle ten.
assumptions: Accessible rim underside, sufficient strip reach and M4 bolt length are indispensable but unprovided; inspect before fabrication. No extra hardware is assumed.
Bolt locations can register edges without puncturing or permanently deforming original parts; otherwise reject this construction.
Cord can keep hardware recoverable while the withdrawn assembly leaves the full marked opening clear.
Loosening and withdrawing yokes can meet 30 seconds; test rather than infer.
Ninety fabrication minutes and twenty observation minutes suffice for this sequence; if fabrication or readings consume the allowance, feasibility remains unestablished.
Reject if card-induced rocking, pad slip, excessive compression, or geometric clearance defeats the requirements.

assessment: One conditional-on-geometry probe, not deployment or demonstrated performance. Inspect feasibility first; do not relax constraints to make the yokes fit.
